title: Tech view: a line becomes read-only once its authorization is approved
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view.
  2. A work order has a newly created line whose authorization is still pending.
custom_steps:
1. Edit the pending line and confirm the edit works.
  2. As another user who can approve, approve the line.
  3. Back as the Tech view user, try to edit the now-approved line.
custom_expected:
Editing works while the line is pending.

After it is approved, the line is read-only and cannot be edited.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: approved-WO lines showed only tech status actions (Complete/Story/Start) with no edit control (consistent with read-only), but the pending->approved edit-lock transition was not directly exercised.
evidence: Needs live UI + a second user.
